reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established oxidation behavior of Al- and Si-containing alloys forming stable, slow-growing oxide scales, which is scientifically consistent.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled experiments with distinct alloy compositions, environmental conditions, and clear pass/fail criteria provide a direct way to confirm or refute the mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a targeted approach to identify the role of specific elements in forming protective oxide scales at high temperatures, guiding further research and alloy design.
